skills.name: Java (8–21)
skills.desc: Modern Java: streams, records, collections, concurrency and JVM basics.
skills.check: You can write and explain Java 17/21 code using streams, records, generics and concurrency without looking things up.

skills.name: Go
skills.desc: Go for backend services: goroutines, channels, interfaces, modules.
skills.check: You've built and tested a small Go service using goroutines/channels and can explain Go's concurrency model.

skills.name: Python
skills.desc: Python for scripting, integrations and data/AI work.
skills.check: You can write a clean Python script or small service (venv, typing, pytest) and use it for integrations or data tasks.

skills.name: JavaScript (ES6+) & TypeScript
skills.desc: Modern JS (async/await, modules, DOM and browser APIs) plus TypeScript's type system.
skills.check: You can write typed TypeScript and explain closures, promises, the event loop and DOM basics.

skills.name: Groovy scripting
skills.desc: JVM scripting language used for Pricefx logic and in Gradle/Jenkins scripts.
skills.check: You can read and write simple Groovy scripts with closures and collections.

skills.name: C/C++ basics
skills.desc: Familiarity with C/C++ syntax and memory model (listed as a bonus).
skills.check: You can read C++ code and write a small program using pointers/references and STL containers.

skills.name: Spring & Spring Boot
skills.desc: Spring Boot/MVC: dependency injection, configuration, REST controllers, validation, actuator.
skills.check: You can build and deploy a production-style Spring Boot REST service and explain auto-configuration and the bean lifecycle.

skills.name: Spring Security & AuthN/AuthZ
skills.desc: Securing Spring apps: filter chain, authentication, roles and method security, CSRF/CORS.
skills.check: You've secured a Spring Boot API with JWT/OAuth2 and role-based access, and can explain the filter chain.

skills.name: Hibernate / JPA
skills.desc: ORM mapping, lazy loading, transactions, the N+1 problem, query tuning.
skills.check: You can model relations in JPA, spot and fix N+1 queries, and explain transaction boundaries.

skills.name: Node.js / Express
skills.desc: Server-side JavaScript with Express: routing, middleware, async patterns.
skills.check: You've built a REST API in Express with middleware, validation and a database connection.

skills.name: Vert.x & event-driven apps
skills.desc: Reactive, event-loop based JVM toolkit for event-driven services.
skills.check: You can build a small Vert.x service with verticles and the event bus, and explain why not to block the event loop.

skills.name: Java Swing (desktop)
skills.desc: Legacy Java desktop UI toolkit still used in some enterprise apps.
skills.check: You can build a basic Swing app with layouts and listeners and respect the Event Dispatch Thread rule.

skills.name: REST & SOAP web services
skills.desc: Designing HTTP APIs (status codes, versioning, pagination, OpenAPI) and consuming SOAP/WSDL services.
skills.check: You can design a clean REST API with OpenAPI docs and consume a SOAP service from a WSDL.

skills.name: gRPC & Protobuf
skills.desc: Binary RPC with schema-first Protobuf contracts and streaming.
skills.check: You've defined a .proto, generated stubs and built a client/server including a streaming call.

skills.name: GraphQL & AWS AppSync
skills.desc: Schema-based query API; AppSync is AWS's managed GraphQL service.
skills.check: You can design a schema and resolvers, explain GraphQL vs REST trade-offs, and have tried AppSync.

skills.name: Microservices architecture
skills.desc: Service boundaries, API gateways, resilience patterns, data ownership and deployment.
skills.check: You can explain how to split a monolith and have built 2+ services with resilience (retries, circuit breakers).

skills.name: Distributed systems & data consistency
skills.desc: CAP, idempotency, sagas, eventual consistency, concurrency and distributed transactions.
skills.check: You can explain sagas, the outbox pattern and idempotency, and handle high-concurrency consistency in a demo.

skills.name: Kafka & RabbitMQ
skills.desc: Message brokers and event streaming: topics, partitions, consumer groups, acknowledgements.
skills.check: You've built a producer/consumer pair on Kafka (and tried RabbitMQ) and can explain delivery guarantees.

skills.name: System design & architecture
skills.desc: Designing scalable systems, weighing trade-offs, caching, capacity and writing technical proposals.
skills.check: You can whiteboard a scalable system and document the trade-offs in a short design doc.

skills.name: ETL/ELT & CDC pipelines
skills.desc: Moving and transforming data between systems; change data capture (e.g. Debezium).
skills.check: You've built a small ETL/ELT flow and a CDC pipeline from a database into another sink.

skills.name: SQL & relational databases
skills.desc: SQL queries, joins, indexing and execution plans on Oracle/MySQL/PostgreSQL/MS SQL; schema design.
skills.check: You can write complex joins and window functions, design a normalised schema and read an EXPLAIN plan.

skills.name: NoSQL databases
skills.desc: Document/key-value stores such as MongoDB or DynamoDB: modelling and tuning.
skills.check: You've modelled data in MongoDB (or DynamoDB), added indexes and can explain when NoSQL beats SQL.

skills.name: Large-dataset processing
skills.desc: Processing big or streaming data efficiently: batching, partitioning, parallelism.
skills.check: You can process a multi-GB dataset efficiently and explain your partitioning and batching choices.

skills.name: React (state & async data)
skills.desc: React components, hooks, state management, async data fetching and reusable component design.
skills.check: You've built a React app with hooks, shared state and API calls using reusable components.

skills.name: Next.js / Angular
skills.desc: Next.js (SSR/SSG, routing) and Angular as alternative frontend frameworks.
skills.check: You've built a small Next.js app with SSR/SSG and can read Angular components and services.

skills.name: HTML5, CSS & responsive design
skills.desc: Semantic HTML, modern CSS (flex/grid) and responsive layouts.
skills.check: You can build a responsive page from a design using semantic HTML and flex/grid.

skills.name: Frontend tooling & performance
skills.desc: Webpack/Vite, Babel, npm; bundle size, lazy loading, Core Web Vitals.
skills.check: You can analyse a bundle, apply code-splitting/lazy-loading and improve a Lighthouse score.

skills.name: Accessibility (WCAG/ARIA)
skills.desc: Building UIs that work with keyboards and screen readers, per WCAG.
skills.check: You can audit a page for WCAG issues and fix them with semantic HTML and ARIA.

skills.name: AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, RDS)
skills.desc: Core AWS services for building and deploying cloud-native applications.
skills.check: You've deployed an app using ECS or Lambda with S3 and RDS, and understand IAM and VPC basics.

skills.name: Google Cloud (GCP)
skills.desc: Core GCP services: Cloud Run/GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud SQL.
skills.check: You've deployed a service on GCP (Cloud Run or GKE) and used Pub/Sub or BigQuery.

skills.name: Docker & containers
skills.desc: Images, Dockerfiles, compose, image hardening.
skills.check: You can containerise an app with a multi-stage Dockerfile and run it with docker compose.

skills.name: Kubernetes & Helm
skills.desc: Container orchestration: deployments, services, config/secrets, Helm charts.
skills.check: You can deploy an app to Kubernetes with a Helm chart and debug a failing pod.

skills.name: CI/CD pipelines
skills.desc: Automated build, test and deploy with Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
skills.check: You've built a pipeline that builds, tests and deploys an app (Jenkins or GitHub Actions).

skills.name: Infrastructure as Code
skills.desc: Terraform/CloudFormation/Pulumi to provision infrastructure reproducibly.
skills.check: You've provisioned a small cloud stack from scratch with Terraform or CloudFormation.

skills.name: Monitoring & observability
skills.desc: Logs, metrics and traces (Datadog, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry) and SRE basics.
skills.check: You've instrumented a service with metrics/traces and built an alert and a dashboard.

skills.name: Linux & Windows environments
skills.desc: Shell, processes, permissions, networking; deploying on Linux/Windows servers.
skills.check: You're comfortable on the Linux shell: permissions, services, logs, networking and basic bash scripts.

skills.name: Maven & Gradle
skills.desc: Java build and dependency management, including resolving CVEs in transitive dependencies.
skills.check: You can manage multi-module builds and BOMs and resolve dependency conflicts and CVEs.

skills.name: Git workflows
skills.desc: Branching, rebasing, pull-request flow and conflict resolution.
skills.check: You can rebase, cherry-pick, resolve conflicts and explain a branching strategy.

skills.name: OOP, SOLID & design patterns
skills.desc: Object-oriented design, SOLID principles and common design patterns, with trade-offs.
skills.check: You can name and apply common GoF patterns and refactor a code smell using SOLID.

skills.name: Data structures & algorithms
skills.desc: Core data structures and algorithms, plus complexity analysis.
skills.check: You can solve medium-level problems (graphs, DP, heaps) and explain their time/space complexity.

skills.name: JUnit & Mockito
skills.desc: Unit and integration testing for Java with JUnit 5 and Mockito.
skills.check: You write JUnit 5 tests with Mockito mocks and meaningful assertions, with solid coverage.

skills.name: TDD & quality engineering
skills.desc: Test-driven development and wider QE practice (unit, integration, contract, E2E tests).
skills.check: You've built a feature test-first and can explain unit vs integration vs contract tests.

skills.name: Debugging, RCA & production support
skills.desc: Tracing production issues through logs/metrics to root cause and writing RCAs.
skills.check: You can trace a production issue to its root cause and write a clear RCA.

skills.name: Legacy code & framework upgrades
skills.desc: Upgrading Java 8→17, Spring 4→6 and libraries; modernising legacy apps safely.
skills.check: You've upgraded a legacy Spring/Java app across major versions and fixed the resulting breakages.

skills.name: OWASP Top 10 & secure coding
skills.desc: Common web vulnerabilities and how to prevent them in code and configuration.
skills.check: You can explain each OWASP Top 10 item and fix SQLi, XSS, CSRF and SSRF in Java code.

skills.name: SAST/DAST/SCA tools
skills.desc: SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx, Fortify, OWASP Dependency-Check, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP.
skills.check: You've run SonarQube/Snyk and Dependency-Check on a project, triaged findings and verified a fix with ZAP or Burp.

skills.name: OAuth 2.0, JWT & SAML
skills.desc: Token-based and federated authentication standards.
skills.check: You can explain the OAuth2 flows and JWT validation and implement a login with an identity provider.

skills.name: AI coding assistants
skills.desc: Using Copilot/Cursor/Claude Code productively and validating their output.
skills.check: You use an AI assistant daily and can explain how you validate its output and where it fails.

skills.name: LLMs & GenAI APIs
skills.desc: Model APIs, prompting, structured output and cost/latency/model trade-offs.
skills.check: You've integrated an LLM API into an app with prompt design, streaming and cost/latency control.

skills.name: Agent frameworks
skills.desc: LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI; tool calling and multi-agent orchestration.
skills.check: You've built an agent with tool-calling and multi-step orchestration.

skills.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
skills.desc: Protocol for exposing tools and data to AI agents; building MCP servers and clients.
skills.check: You've built a small MCP server and connected it to a client.

skills.name: RAG & vector databases
skills.desc: Embeddings, chunking, vector search and semantic retrieval.
skills.check: You've built a RAG pipeline with embeddings and a vector store and checked retrieval quality.

skills.name: LLM gateways, guardrails & AI observability
skills.desc: Rate limiting, guardrails, prompt management and tracing LLM calls (OpenTelemetry, LangSmith).
skills.check: You can add a gateway and guardrails to an LLM app and trace its calls end to end.

skills.name: Pricefx platform (Configuration Engineer)
skills.desc: Pricing SaaS platform; Sysco LABS expects the Pricefx Configuration Engineer certification.
skills.check: You've completed Pricefx training and passed the Configuration Engineer certification.

skills.name: Payments, ledgers & reconciliation
skills.desc: Fintech basics: payment gateways, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation.
skills.check: You can explain double-entry ledgers and reconciliation and have modelled a simple ledger service.

skills.name: Statistical / data-intensive apps
skills.desc: Numerical accuracy, analytics and visualisation-heavy applications.
skills.check: You've built a feature with statistical calculations/visualisations while handling precision correctly.

skills.name: Agile/Scrum, Jira & estimation
skills.desc: Scrum ceremonies, Jira boards, planning and reliable task estimation.
skills.check: You can take part in Scrum ceremonies, use Jira well and give reliable estimates.

skills.name: Mentoring & technical leadership
skills.desc: Code reviews, guiding juniors, owning technical decisions.
skills.check: You've mentored a junior through code reviews and led a small technical effort.

skills.name: Communication & stakeholder collaboration
skills.desc: Clear written and verbal communication with teams, clients and non-technical stakeholders.
skills.check: You can present a technical decision clearly in writing and verbally to non-technical stakeholders.
